programme.desc: Based on the true story of a group of Allied POWs who engineered a bold escape from a Nazi camp during World War II. The escape committee's plan is to liberate hundreds of inmates and cause havoc throughout occupied territory, but their problems include concealing three tunnels from the guards and disposing of numerous tons of soil.

programme.desc: A whimsical but engaging western about a drifter who saves a woman from a gang of marauders. The cowboy is astonished to learn that the woman is a nun, especially when he witnesses her heavy drinking and cigar-smoking ways. The unlikely pair embarks on a voyage of discovery as they become embroiled in the Mexican War.

He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes.

programme.desc: A pair of transit policemen decide to raid a New York subway train loaded with money. Foster brothers John and Charlie have held a lifelong fantasy of robbing the network's money train, which collects millions of dollars each night from the city's subway stations. In addition to trying to deceive their boss, the boys must also contend with a beautiful new decoy cop.

Their only lead is a young woman who can identify the culprits, but when they track her down, she mistakes one of the cops for his partner, forcing the pair into a bizarre and chaotic life swap.

Unaware of their military prowess, the shop keeper takes delivery of the soldiers, who break free from their packaging to attack their Gorgonite enemies. When the Gorgonites communicate with the shop keeper's son, the humans find themselves under siege.

Devastated, he seeks solace in the arms of a waitress, but sneaks off into the night once he's had his fun. The spurned waitress exacts her revenge by moving into the empty house and masquerading as Newton's wife. At this stage, things start getting complicated.

programme.desc: The hard-nosed Detroit cop from the original film returns to Los Angeles to help solve another case. This time he must direct his efforts towards unravelling the Alphabet Crimes, a series of robberies committed by leather-jacketed punks. The investigation puts him on the trail of an illegal arms dealer and his hit lady.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop III
programme.desc: Axel Foley and his Beverly Hills buddies investigate criminal activities at a Southern California amusement park.

programme.title: Midnight Express
programme.desc: Based on the true story of an American who endured the horrors of a Turkish prison after his arrest on drug charges.

programme.title: Jules
programme.desc: A man's quiet life gets upended when a UFO crashes in his backyard in rural Pennsylvania. As he befriends the mysterious extraterrestrial, things start to get complicated when two neighbours discover it and the government quickly closes in.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: A leaving party for New Yorker Rob Hawkins is rudely interrupted by the arrival of an unwelcome guest, something that has a penchant for smashing up skyscrapers, playing football with the Statue of Liberty's head and handpicking humans as snacks.

programme.title: The Book of Clarence
programme.desc: A down-on-his-luck man struggles to find a better life for his family while fighting to free himself of debt. Captivated by the power and glory of the rising Messiah, he risks everything to carve his own path to a divine life.

programme.title: Widow Clicquot
programme.desc: The story behind the Veuve Clicquot champagne family and business that began in the late 18th century.

programme.title: The Men Who Stare at Goats
programme.desc: A reporter in Iraq may just have the story of a lifetime when he meets Lyn Cassady, a guy who claims to be a former member of the US Army's New Earth Army, a unit that employs paranormal powers in their missions.

programme.title: The Birds
programme.desc: Socialite Melanie follows a handsome lawyer back to his coastal home. She is menaced by birds on the road and has to take cover as the aerial attacks intensify. Based on Daphne du Maurier's story.

programme.title: Ouija
programme.desc: A group of friends must confront their most terrifying fears when they awaken the dark powers of an ancient spirit board.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: CIA agent Jack Ryan finds himself the target of an IRA revenge plot after he foils a terrorist attack in London.

programme.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
programme.desc: An apocalyptic story set in the furthest reaches of our planet, in a stark desert landscape where humanity is broken. Two rebels on the run may be able to restore order.

programme.title: Crazy Rich Asians
programme.desc: Rachel Chu is happy to accompany her longtime boyfriend, Nick, to his best friend's wedding in Singapore. She's also surprised to learn that Nick's family is extremely wealthy and he's considered one of the country's most eligible bachelors. Thrust into the spotlight, Rachel must now contend with jealous socialites, quirky relatives and something far, far worse: Nick's disapproving mother.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky

programme.title: Vita y Virginia: Historia de un amor prohibido
programme.desc: La escritora Virginia Wolf conoce a la también escritora Vita Sackville-West en Londres en la década de 1920. A pesar de que ambas están casadas, entre ellas nace una pasión que la moral de la época prohíbe y que, más tarde, inspirará una de los libros más conocidos de Wolf.

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider

programme.title: El menú

programme.desc: Jasmine is a successful fashion editor living with her fiance. On a night out in the city with her best friend, she meets Dallas, a roofer recently out of a relationship. Surprised by the confidence with which Dallas pursues her, Jasmine turns Dallas down but can't get her out of her head. When Jasmine finally succumbs, the two women embark on a steamy affair that forces them both to re-evaluate their lives.

programme.title: Poor Boy's Game
programme.desc: Boxer Donnie (Rossif Sutherland), jailed for nine years after causing brain damage to a boy he assaulted, is finally released. Donnie is regretful and wishes to move on, but the community is still tense with racial division. The impaired boy's black family wants revenge, and Donnie's white relatives are eager for a fight, so a boxing match with a powerful young black man (Flex Alexander) is scheduled. Amid the conflict, Donnie forms an unlikely friendship with his victim's father (Danny Glover).

programme.title: Sanctuary

programme.title: Sanctuary

programme.title: Cairo Time
programme.desc: With some time off from her job as a magazine editor, New Yorker Juliette (Patricia Clarkson) decides to share a holiday with her husband, who works for the United Nations. Upon arriving in Cairo, however, she finds he's stuck in Gaza, and he sends his former bodyguard, Tareq (Alexander Siddig) -- now relocated back in Cairo to work at his family business -- to act as her guide around the city. Soon Juliette finds herself captivated by both the city and her companion.

programme.title: The Karate Kid

Though he knows a little karate, his fighting skills are no match for Cheng, the school bully. Dre finds a friend in Mr. Han, a maintenance man who is also a martial-arts master. Mr. Han teaches Dre all about kung fu in the hope that Dre will be able to face down Cheng and perhaps win the heart of a pretty classmate named Mei Ying.

programme.title: Manufactured Landscapes
programme.desc: This documentary reveals the gritty underside of industrial landscapes. Photographer Edward Burtynsky explores the subtle beauty amid the waste generated by slag heaps, dumps and factories. Memorable scenes include a Chinese iron factory where employees are berated to produce faster, and shots of children playing atop piles of dangerous debris. The contrasts between wealth and poverty are most striking in Shanghai, with new high-rises towering above old slums.

programme.title: The Incredible 25th Year of Mitzi Bearclaw
programme.desc: Mitzi Bearclaw's dream to design cool hats is put on hold when she decides to move back to her isolated reserve to look after her sick mother.

programme.title: The LEGO Movie
programme.desc: An ordinary LEGO figurine Emmet who always follows the rules, is mistakenly identified as an extraordinary being and the key to saving the world. He finds himself drafted into a fellowship of strangers who are on a mission to stop an evil tyrant's plans to conquer the world. Unfortunately for Emmet, he is hopelessly and hilariously unprepared for such a task, but he'll give it his all nonetheless.

programme.title: Captain Underpants
programme.desc: Jorge and Berto make the headmaster believe he is a superhero.

programme.title: Stuart Little
programme.desc: When the Littles go to an orphanage to adopt a new family member, a charming young mouse named Stuart is chosen. While George is initially unwelcoming to his new brother, the family cat, Snowbell, is even less enthusiastic about having a mouse as his "master" and plots to get rid of him. Against these difficulties, Stuart resolves to face them with as much pluck, love and courage as he can muster. In doing so, he shows his beloved new family that great things can truly come in small packages.

programme.title: Stuart Little 2
programme.desc: Plucky, pint-sized hero Stuart Little (Michael J. Fox) returns in "Stuart Little 2," delighting audiences with his big heart and even more action-packed adventure. This time, Stuart must journey through the city with a reluctant Snowbell (Nathan Lane) to rescue a new friend, Margalo (Melanie Griffith), from a villainous Falcon (James Woods).

programme.title: The Theory of Everything
programme.desc: In the 1960s, Cambridge University student and future physicist Stephen Hawking (Eddie Redmayne) falls in love with fellow collegian Jane Wilde (Felicity Jones). At 21, Hawking learns that he has motor neuron disease. Despite this -- and with Jane at his side -- he begins an ambitious study of time, of which he has very little left, according to his doctor. He and Jane defy terrible odds and break new ground in the fields of medicine and science, achieving more than either could hope to imagine.

programme.title: Spartacus: Blood and Sand
programme.desc: After a shameful performance in the arena with Crixus, Spartacus is forced to fight in the Pits; Batiatus is determined to profit from Spartacus.

programme.title: Spartacus: Blood and Sand
programme.desc: Batiatus is given a gladitorial opportunity of a lifetime; Crixus and Spartacus must learn to fight as a team against an unbeaten opponent.

programme.title: Rebelle
programme.desc: African rebels force a village girl (Rachel Mwanza) to kill her own parents and join their army, but a miraculous event makes the rebels think she has supernatural powers.

programme.title: Diamond Tongues
programme.desc: Edith dreams of being a successful actress, but cannot land any roles. When she can't figure out what she is doing wrong, she starts to mess everything up.

programme.title: Come to Daddy
programme.desc: A privileged man-child arrives at the beautiful and remote coastal cabin of his estranged father, whom he hasn't seen in 30 years. He quickly discovers that not only is his dad a jerk, he also has a shady past that is rushing to catch up with him.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Henry and a UK based Sanctuary team investigate a gruesome murder on board a stranded icebreaker in the Bering Sea.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: When a previously unknown Abnormal attacks Abby, Magnus and Will attempt to communicate with the creature using music, while Henry and Gavin retrace Abby's steps to find out what happened.

programme.title: Cooking With Stella
programme.desc: A woman cooks for clients and tries to keep her thefts of food and money from being discovered.

programme.title: The Dark Crystal
programme.desc: Jen (Stephen Garlick), raised by the noble race called the Mystics, has been told that he is the last survivor of his own race, the Gelflings. He sets out to try to find a shard of the dark crystal, a powerful gem that once provided balance to the universe. After the crystal was broken, the evil Skeksis used sinister means to gain control. Jen believes that he can repair the dark crystal and bring peace back to the world, if he can only find the remaining shard.

programme.title: Catwoman
programme.desc: Shy, sensitive artist Patience Philips can't seem to stop apologizing for her own existence. She works as a graphic designer for Hedare Beauty, a mammoth cosmetics company on the verge of releasing a revolutionary anti-aging product. When Patience inadvertently happens upon a dark secret her employer is hiding, she finds herself in the middle of a corporate conspiracy.

programme.title: Eve & the Fire Horse
programme.desc: Eve Eng (Phoebe Jojo Kut) is the 9-year-old daughter of Buddhist Chinese immigrants living in Vancouver, British Columbia. Although Eve has been raised with her family's traditional Chinese beliefs, she begins to doubt that their religion can see her family through a string of misfortunes. Much to the dismay of their traditionally-minded family members, Eve and her equally independent sister, Karena (Hollie Lo), take a new and unusual path: they discover Catholicism.

programme.title: Life of Pi
programme.desc: After deciding to sell their zoo in India and move to Canada, Santosh and Gita Patel board a freighter with their sons and a few remaining animals. Tragedy strikes when a terrible storm sinks the ship, leaving the Patels' teenage son, Pi (Suraj Sharma), as the only human survivor. However, Pi is not alone; a fearsome Bengal tiger has also found refuge aboard the lifeboat. As days turn into weeks and weeks drag into months, Pi and the tiger must learn to trust each other if both are to survive.

programme.title: A League of Their Own
programme.desc: As America's stock of athletic young men is depleted during World War II, a professional all-female baseball league springs up in the Midwest, funded by publicity-hungry candy maker Walter Harvey (Garry Marshall). Competitive sisters Dottie Hinson (Geena Davis) and Kit Keller (Lori Petty) spar with each other, scout Ernie Capadino (Jon Lovitz) and grumpy has-been coach Jimmy Dugan (Tom Hanks) on their way to fame. Madonna and Rosie O'Donnell co-star as two of the sisters' teammates.

In 1946, Branch Rickey (Harrison Ford), legendary manager of the Brooklyn Dodgers, defies major league baseball's notorious color barrier by signing Jackie Robinson (Chadwick Boseman) to the team. The heroic act puts both Rickey and Robinson in the firing line of the public, the press and other players. Facing open racism from all sides, Robinson demonstrates true courage and admirable restraint by not reacting in kind and lets his undeniable talent silence the critics for him.

programme.title: Percy
programme.desc: Percy Schmeiser, a third-generation farmer, gets sued by a corporate giant for allegedly using their patented seeds. With little resources to fight a legal battle, Percy joins forces with up-and-coming attorney Jackson Weaver and environmental activist Rebecca Salcau for a monumental case that leads all the way to the Supreme Court.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: When his young children are abducted by his old nemesis, Capt. Hook (Dustin Hoffman), middle-aged lawyer Peter Banning (Robin Williams) returns to his magical origins as Peter Pan. Peter must revisit a foggy past in which he abandoned Neverland for family life, leaving Tinkerbell (Julia Roberts) and the Lost Boys to fend for themselves. Given their bitterness toward Peter for growing up -- and their allegiance to their new leader, Rufio -- the old gang may not be happy to see him.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: With a government inspector threatening to cut off the Sanctuary's funding, Magnus and Will must explain a failed mission.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Magnus flies to Africa to meet Sanctuary's secret financial advisor but ends up in a deadly hostage situation.

programme.title: Meditation Park
programme.desc: A dutiful wife and mother re-examines her veneration of her husband after she finds another woman's underwear in his laundry.

programme.title: Nanny McPhee Returns
programme.desc: Enigmatic Nanny McPhee (Emma Thompson) arrives on the doorstep of a harried mother, Isabel Green (Maggie Gyllenhaal), who is trying to raise her kids and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war. Isabel has her hands full with not only her own three, but also with her sister's spoiled pair. With no time to lose, McPhee uses magic to instill in the children five important lessons.

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An unemployed actor disguises himself as an elderly nanny in order to spend more time with his estranged family.

programme.title: Easy A
programme.desc: Prompted by her popular best friend to spill details of her boring weekend, Olive, a clean-cut teen, decides to spice things up by telling a little lie about losing her virginity; when the high-school busybody overhears the conversation and spreads it all over campus, Olive is suddenly notorious but for the wrong reasons.

programme.title: The Breakfast Club
programme.desc: Five high school students from different walks of life endure a Saturday detention under a power-hungry principal. The disparate group includes rebel John, princess Claire, outcast Allison, brainy Brian and Andrew, the jock. Each has a chance to tell his or her story, making the others see them a little differently -- and when the day ends, they question whether school will ever be the same.

programme.title: Lean on Me
programme.desc: In this fact-based film, a New Jersey superintendent, Dr. Frank Napier (Robert Guillaume), watches helplessly as East Side High becomes the lowest-ranked school in the state. With nowhere else to turn, Dr. Napier enlists maverick ex-teacher Joe Clark (Morgan Freeman) to take over as principal of the declining school. Unfortunately for Clark, before he can focus on improving the student body's state exam scores, he has to somehow rid the school of its gang and narcotics problems.

programme.title: The Trotsky
programme.desc: A teenager from Montreal believes that he is the reincarnation of Russian revolutionary Leon Trotsky.

programme.desc: Dr. Parnassus (Christopher Plummer), the leader of a traveling show, has a dark secret. Thousands of years ago he traded the soul of his daughter, Valentina, to the devil. Now the devil has come to collect his prize. To save her, Parnassus must make a final wager: Whoever collects five souls first will win Valentina. Tony (Heath Ledger), a man saved from hanging by Parnassus' troupe, agrees to help collect them, with his eye on marrying Valentina.

Blu is thought to be the last of his kind, but when word comes that Jewel (Anne Hathaway), a lone female, lives in Rio de Janeiro, Blu and Linda go to meet her. Animal smugglers kidnap Blu and Jewel, but the pair soon escape and begin a perilous adventure back to freedom -- and Linda.

Unfortunately for her younger sister, Bianca, house rules say that she can't date until Kat has a boyfriend, so strings are pulled to set the dour damsel up for a romance. Soon Kat crosses paths with handsome new arrival Patrick Verona. Kat may let her guard down enough to fall for the effortlessly charming Patrick.

programme.title: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
programme.desc: Socially awkward Charlie is a wallflower watching from the sidelines, until a pair of charismatic seniors take him under their wing.

When he solves a difficult graduate-level math problem, his talents are discovered by Professor Gerald Lambeau (Stellan Skarsgard), who decides to help the misguided youth reach his potential. When Will is arrested for attacking a police officer, Professor Lambeau makes a deal to get leniency for him if he will get treatment from therapist Sean Maguire (Robin Williams).

programme.desc: Disillusioned with the tedium of his existence, psychiatrist Hector confesses to his girlfriend that he feels he is a fraud for dispensing recommendations to patients who never seem to improve or get any happier. He considers breaking out of his lackluster routine. Summoning up some courage, Hector gives his starved curiosity free rein and embarks on an international quest to find the right formula to bring him joy and vitality.

programme.title: Easy Land
programme.desc: A mentally ill Serbian architect tries to build a better future for her daughter in Canada.

programme.desc: Jade Li (Sandra Oh) is an independent 22-year-old Chinese-Canadian struggling to live the life she wants while not disappointing her traditional Chinese parents. In an effort to encourage their daughter to start a family, Jade's parents set her up on a series of dates with nice, traditional Chinese boys, but Jade is not interested. When she meets a Caucasian grad student named Mark (Callum Rennie), she has to decide how much her own happiness is worth.

programme.title: Tia and Piujuq

Upon investigation of the speck, Horton discovers the tiny city of Who-ville and its residents, the Whos, which he can hear but cannot see. Horton forms a friendship with the mayor of Who-ville, Ned McDodd (Steve Carell), and promises to transport Who-ville to safety. However, Horton encounters opposition from his jungle neighbors, who don't want to believe in the existence of Who-ville.

programme.desc: In this animated film, explorer Ted (Will Ferrell) journeys to Africa hoping to recover an important artifact for his friend Bloomsberry (Dick Van Dyke), a museum director. Instead, however, he discovers an irrepressible little primate named George, who stows away on the ship back to New York City. There, Ted tries to stop plans to demolish the museum, but he has his hands full taking care of his new simian friend, whose curiosity may turn out to be more beneficial than anyone had imagined.

A royal decree awards Arrakis to Duke Leto Atreides and ousts his bitter enemies, the Harkonnens. However, when the Harkonnens violently seize back their fiefdom, it is up to Paul (Kyle MacLachlan), Leto's son, to lead the Fremen, the natives of Arrakis, in a battle for control of the planet and its spice. Based on Frank Herbert's epic novel.

programme.title: Batman: Mask of the Phantasm
programme.desc: In this animated feature set in the 1940s, the troubled yet heroic Batman (Kevin Conroy) is pitted against a mysterious figure who is rubbing out Gotham City's most dangerous criminals, and who many believe is the caped crusader himself. Batman's alter ego, millionaire Bruce Wayne, is about to get married to the lovely Andrea Beaumont (Dana Delany), who helps him recover from his need to avenge his parents' murder -- meaning that his crime-fighting days may be numbered.

programme.desc: After escaping prison, Kat's own revolver is pointed to his head by an unknown assailant. As the empty rounds click away, he tries to remember what happened to each bullet.

programme.desc: College dropout Steve Jobs (Ashton Kutcher), together with his friend, technical whiz-kid Steve Wozniak (Josh Gad), sparks a revolution in home computers with the invention of the Apple 1 in 1976. Built in the garage of Jobs' parents, the device -- and the subsequent formation of Apple Inc. -- have changed the world for all time. Though he is viewed as a visionary, Jobs' tenure as Apple's leader is a rocky one, leading to his eventual ouster from the company he co-founded.

Then Bradley's wife, Kathryn (Selma Blair), leaves him for someone else. Afterward Bradley marries realtor Diana (Radha Mitchell), who helps the first couple move in together. Harry (Morgan Freeman) watches it all quietly and muses on love and loss.

But, when three formidable opponents also enter the fray, Laura vows to win at any cost, including recruiting her stupid ex-boyfriend (Hugh Jackman) for a bit of sabotage.

programme.desc: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann (Samuel L. Jackson) sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler (Eugene Levy), who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. Two FBI agents (Ray Liotta, Ryan Reynolds) have the difficult task of protecting him from a motley assortment of bounty hunters, hit men and nefarious vixens who are converging on his Lake Tahoe encampment to rub him out and collect a hefty reward.

programme.desc: Lowly FBI clerk Walter Weed (Tom Berenger) unwittingly becomes the target of assassins when gangland kingpin Hal Leuco places a bounty on his life. Soon Ben is the most popular guy in town, but when Justin falls in love for the first time, Ben must refocus his priorities and set about trying to win back his wife.

As much as she enjoys an uninhibited life free of commitment, Amy is really in a rut. While writing a profile about charming and successful sports doctor Aaron Conners, she finds herself actually falling in love for the first time, and what's more, Aaron seems to like her too. Competitive sisters Dottie Hinson (Geena Davis) and Kit Keller (Lori Petty) spar with each other, scout Ernie Capadino (Jon Lovitz) and grumpy has-been coach Jimmy Dugan (Tom Hanks) on their way to fame. Madonna and Rosie O'Donnell co-star as two of the sisters' teammates.

While she struggles to think of something nice to say, her family begins fighting. Kate's father, Daniel (Hank Azaria), secretly works in pornography, while her mother, Lucy (Kelly Preston), has come out of the closet, outraging Lucy's sister, Alice (Debra Winger). As secrets emerge, Kate fights her attraction to ex-boyfriend Ryan (Jesse Bradford).

Now trapped among killers, Sheriff Dutten (Timothy Olyphant) and his wife (Radha Mitchell) and two companions must band together to find a way out before madness and death overtake them.

Desperate to reunite with his girlfriend, Ula (Irene Montalà), he takes advantage of a stroke of good luck and escapes his brutal Spanish captors. Once prison guard Borg (Lluís Homar) realizes Dante is gone, he orders the release of a terrifying robotic dog to hunt him down. Dante slowly discovers that an old nemesis (Paul Naschy) is responsible for all his troubles.

programme.title: Ant-Man
programme.desc: Forced out of his own company by former protégé Darren Cross, Dr. Hank Pym (Michael Douglas) recruits the talents of Scott Lang (Paul Rudd), a master thief just released from prison. The miniature hero must use his new skills to prevent Cross, also known as Yellowjacket, from perfecting the same technology and using it as a weapon for evil.

After a carjacking puts Junior in the hands of a vicious criminal leader, O2 turns to street-smart hustler Coco (Meagan Good) for help. Heat between the pair rises as they go around the law to save Junior and outwit the hoodlums at their back.

programme.title: Imaginary
programme.desc: When Jessica moves back into her childhood home with her family, her youngest stepdaughter, Alice, finds a stuffed bear named Chauncey. As Alice's behavior becomes more and more concerning, Jessica intervenes only to realize that Chauncey is much more than the stuffed toy bear she believed him to be.

programme.title: Summoning Sylvia
programme.desc: Larry and his three best friends head upstate for a weekend getaway at a haunted house. As they sashay through the dusty corridors, they recount the home's legend from 100 years ago: a murderous woman named Sylvia slaughtered her son and buried him beneath the floorboards. As they later hold a high-spirited seance to summon the sinister Sylvia, they wind up welcoming more guests than they bargained for.

programme.title: Saturday Church
programme.desc: Ulysses is a shy and effeminate boy who finds himself coping with new responsibilities as man of the house after the death of his father. Living alongside his mother, younger brother, and conservative aunt, Ulysses is also struggling with questions about his gender identity. He finds an escape by creating a world of fantasy filled with dance and music. Ulysses' journey takes a turn for the better when he finds a vibrant transgender community.

programme.title: 4Play
programme.desc: Unsatisfied with his prior romantic conquests, a Chicago club owner (Wesley Jonathan) tries to juggle relationships with three women at once.

programme.title: Story Ave
programme.desc: After falling in with the wrong crowd, a gifted teen named Kadir tries to rob Luis, a no-nonsense MTA conductor. To Kadir's surprise, Luis offers his friendship and shows the young man how his artistic talent could lead to a better life.

programme.title: Baby Boy
programme.desc: The story of Jody (Tyrese Gibson), a misguided, 20-year-old African-American who is really just a baby boy finally forced-kicking and screaming to face the commitments of real life. Streetwise and jobless, he has not only fathered two children by two different women-Yvette (Taraji P. Henson) and Peanut (Tamara LaSeon Bass) but still lives with his own mother. He can't seem to strike a balance or find direction in his chaotic life.

programme.title: Trim Season
programme.desc: Jobless and searching for purpose, Emma and a group of young people from Los Angeles drive up the coast to make some quick cash by trimming marijuana on a secluded farm. Cut off from the rest of the world, they soon realize that Mona, the owner of the estate, is harboring secrets darker than any of them could have ever imagined.

programme.title: Song of Freedom
programme.desc: After being discovered by prominent composer Gabriel Donozetti (Esme Percy), black laborer John Zinga (Paul Robeson) rises to international stardom as an opera singer in spite of widespread racism. Feeling uneasy, however, in a racially divided society, Zinga turns down a prestigious New York singing contract and instead journeys to his ancestral African homeland. When Zinga is met as an outsider even there, he must struggle for acceptance among the aboriginals from which he descended.

Immediately, barista Oscar (Toby Hemingway) is enamored with her and thrilled when his boss, Bradley (Greg Kinnear), hires her. Then Bradley's wife, Kathryn (Selma Blair), leaves him for someone else. Afterward Bradley marries realtor Diana (Radha Mitchell), who helps the first couple move in together. Harry (Morgan Freeman) watches it all quietly and muses on love and loss.

Charlotte and Alice set out on a road trip across the country, hoping to gain perspective and save the situation from ruin.

She moves on with her life by opening her own practice in a vacant office space in the middle of a small commercial block located across the bay in Oakland, turning the predominately African American and psychologically ignored neighborhood on its emotional ear.

Over the course of three decades, Cecil has a front-row seat to history and the inner workings of the Oval Office. However, his commitment to his "First Family" leads to tension at home, alienating his wife (Oprah Winfrey) and causing conflict with his anti-establishment son.

programme.desc: The members of a Niger Delta community wage a war against their corrupt government and an international oil corporation to save their land from being destroyed by excessive drilling and frequent spills.

Juanita (Loretta Devine) is a relationship counselor but cannot seem to get her love life in order. These three and others become bound together by their experiences.

But when he accidentally delivers a box of cocaine to the wrong address, Leo finds himself in the middle of a bad deal that may just cost him his life.

programme.title: Mo' Better Blues
programme.desc: Financially irresponsible Giant (Spike Lee) manages a jazz group, but his sax player, Shadow (Wesley Snipes), wants to replace him with a better businessman. Bleak (Denzel Washington), the band's trumpeter, then tries to defend his close pal Giant, leading to a power struggle between the two musicians. Meanwhile, as Bleak tries to straighten things out with his band mates and manager, he also must choose to be with either sweet teacher Indigo (Joie Lee) or sultry singer Clarke (Cynda Williams).

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: Years after his squad was ambushed during the Gulf War, Major Ben Marco (Denzel Washington) finds himself having terrible nightmares. He begins to doubt that his fellow squad-mate Sergeant Raymond Shaw (Liev Schreiber), now a vice-presidential candidate, is the hero he remembers him being. As Marco's doubts deepen, Shaw's political power grows, and, when Marco finds a mysterious implant embedded in his back, the memory of what really happened begins to return.

programme.title: A Journal for Jordan
programme.desc: Deployed to Iraq, First Sgt. Charles Monroe King starts to keep a journal of love and advice for his infant son. Back at home, Dana Canedy, a senior editor for The New York Times, revisits the story of her unlikely, life-altering relationship with King and his enduring devotion to his beloved family.

programme.title: Flight
programme.desc: Commercial airline pilot Whip Whitaker (Denzel Washington) has a problem with drugs and alcohol, though so far he's managed to complete his flights safely. His luck runs out when a disastrous mechanical malfunction sends his plane hurtling toward the ground. Whip pulls off a miraculous crash-landing that results in only six lives lost. Shaken to the core, Whip vows to get sober -- but when the crash investigation exposes his addiction, he finds himself in an even worse situation.

As Marco's doubts deepen, Shaw's political power grows, and, when Marco finds a mysterious implant embedded in his back, the memory of what really happened begins to return.

programme.title: Flight
programme.desc: Commercial airline pilot Whip Whitaker (Denzel Washington) has a problem with drugs and alcohol, though so far he's managed to complete his flights safely. His luck runs out when a disastrous mechanical malfunction sends his plane hurtling toward the ground. Whip pulls off a miraculous crash-landing that results in only six lives lost. Shaken to the core, Whip vows to get sober -- but when the crash investigation exposes his addiction, he finds himself in an even worse situation.

programme.title: Elysium
programme.desc: In 2154, the wealthy live in comfort and luxury aboard a space station, while the poor have a hardscrabble existence on the overpopulated and ruined Earth.

programme.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
programme.desc: After being released, a reformed serial killer moves into his family's ancestral estate and is haunted by his past -- both the living and the dead.

programme.title: Night Wolf
programme.desc: A young woman (Isabella Calthorpe) and her family try to fight back against a bloodthirsty creature, only to find that it is already among them.

programme.title: SIGN OFF
programme.desc: Sign off.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Bullied at school, neglected at home and incredibly lonely, 12-year-old Owen (Kodi Smit-McPhee) spends his days plotting revenge on his tormentors and spends his nights spying on other residents of the apartment complex. His sole friend is Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz), a strange girl who comes out only at nighttime. Both outcasts, the two form a strong bond. When Abby's caretaker disappears amid a series of gruesome murders, Owen begins to suspect that she is hiding a terrible secret.

programme.title: Not Easily Broken
programme.desc: Dave Johnson (Morris Chestnut) and his wife, Clarice (Taraji P. Henson), appear to have it all, but she has ignored his needs while she pursues a real-estate career. The couple's already weakened marriage faces the ultimate test after Clarice is involved in a car accident, leaving her with a terrible leg injury. Dave finds a sympathetic ear -- and possibly more -- with the physical therapist (Maeve Quinlan) who comes to treat her.

programme.title: The Other Boleyn Girl
programme.desc: King Henry VIII (Eric Bana) lacks an heir. Seeing this as an opportunity for personal gain, the Duke of Norfolk (David Morrissey) and Sir Thomas Boleyn (Mark Rylance) persuade Thomas' daughter Anne (Natalie Portman) to seduce the king. But Henry falls in love with Anne's sister, Mary (Scarlett Johansson), instead. When Mary becomes pregnant, she's confined to bed, with charged with Anne keeping the king from straying -- but the plan backfires when Anne seeks the king's affections for herself.

programme.title: A Night in Old Mexico
programme.desc: After traveling to Mexico with his grandson (Jeremy Irvine), a rancher (Robert Duvall) finds stolen money from a drug deal.

When the state threatens to pull the plug on the school in light of her report, Seabrook and bumbling vice principal Tom Willoman (Jason Biggs) struggle to save the place from closing.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: Staff Sgt. William James (Jeremy Renner), Sgt. J.T. Sanborn (Anthony Mackie) and Specialist Owen Eldridge (Brian Geraghty) are members of a bomb-disposal unit in Baghdad. As their tour of duty enters its final weeks, the men face a set of increasingly hazardous situations, any of which could end their lives in an explosive instant.

programme.title: Bring It On Again
programme.desc: College freshman Whittier (Anne Judson-Yager) and her friend Monica (Faune A. Chambers) make the Cal State cheerleading squad, but can't stand its snobbish leader, Tina (Bree Turner). They resolve to form their own team, pulling together a collection of geeky art students and hippie bleeding hearts whose extracurricular programs were cut for budgetary reasons. Through teamwork, they challenge the official squad's right to represent the school at the upcoming cheerleading championship.

However, his dreams are challenged by Detroit's auto manufacturers, production problems and accusations of stock fraud, and he is forced to defend his dream and honesty in court.

programme.desc: A bank robber (Stephen Dorff) commandeers a car occupied by a woman (Maria Bello) and her 5-year-old son (Connor Hill).

Brother Jesse still pines for an old flame, eldest brother Mauricio now has a high-powered wife who is more interested in career than children and matriarch Anna drops a bombshell when she announces her intention to divorce her children's father.

programme.title: The Last Warrior
programme.desc: A man (Dolph Lundgren) leads earthquake survivors against a gang of violent convicts bent on ruling the world.

programme.desc: Kicked out of his home in Pennsylvania, Paul travels to New York City and finds romance with a woman who, unbeknownst to him, is transgender. As they start to learn more about each other, Paul's lies and double life begin to surface.

programme.title: Crave
programme.desc: Aiden yearns for a better life and to get away from his grisly job as a crime scene photographer. As his dark imagination leaks into reality, he meets a younger woman with her own problems and begins to live out his vigilante fantasies.

programme.title: The Sweeney
programme.desc: Members (Ray Winstone, Ben Drew, Hayley Atwell) of an elite British police squad use questionable and aggressive methods to nab criminals.

programme.title: A Journal for Jordan
programme.desc: Deployed to Iraq, First Sgt. Charles Monroe King starts to keep a journal of love and advice for his infant son. Back at home, Dana Canedy, a senior editor for The New York Times, revisits the story of her unlikely, life-altering relationship with King and his enduring devotion to his beloved family.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: In 1931, the Bondurant brothers of Franklin County, Va., run a multipurpose backwoods establishment that hides their true business, bootlegging. Middle brother Forrest (Tom Hardy) is the brain of the operation; older Howard (Jason Clarke) is the brawn, and younger Jack (Shia LaBeouf), the lookout. Though the local police have taken bribes and left the brothers alone, a violent war erupts when a sadistic lawman (Guy Pearce) from Chicago arrives and tries to shut down the Bondurants operation.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's the Family That Preys
programme.desc: Despite their differences in social class, Charlotte (Kathy Bates) and Alice (Alfre Woodard) are good friends for many years. Then secrets, greed and scandal surrounding both their families throw the women's lives into turmoil. Charlotte and Alice set out on a road trip across the country, hoping to gain perspective and save the situation from ruin.

programme.desc: Elizabeth Tudor (Cate Blanchett) becomes queen of a divided and dangerous England in 1558. She is roundly perceived as weak by threats from within and abroad, and she is strongly advised to marry by counsel William Cecil (Richard Attenborough). But she will be married only to her country. Intelligent and cautious, she must choose where to place her trust: with her shrewd secretary Walsingham (Geoffrey Rush), a master of espionage, or her secret lover, Sir Robert Dudley (Joseph Fiennes).

programme.title: Elizabeth: The Golden Age
programme.desc: In the 16th century, the Queen of England must protect her country against an imperialistic Spain, her own people and the desires of her heart.

Their quiet life together is soon shattered when a group of unseemly criminals kidnaps her. Norman is now forced to tap into even darker and more creative instincts in an effort to save her.

But, when a defector accuses her of being a Russian spy, Salt's oath is put to the test. Now a fugitive, Salt must use every skill gained from years of training and experience to evade capture, but the more she tries to prove her innocence, the more guilty she seems.

Peter, with assistance from the fairy Tink (Ludivine Sagnier), must face Hook in order to rescue the Darlings.

programme.title: The Flintstones
programme.desc: Big-hearted, dim-witted factory worker Fred Flintstone (John Goodman) lends money to his friend Barney Rubble (Rick Moranis) so that he can adopt a baby. As thanks, Barney swaps his IQ test for Fred's during an executive search program. After getting promoted, however, Fred becomes embroiled in the dastardly scheming of his boss Cliff Vandercave (Kyle MacLachlan), who enlists his secretary, Sharon Stone (Halle Berry), to seduce Fred, angering Fred's wife, Wilma (Elizabeth Perkins).

programme.title: The Flintstones in Viva Rock Vegas
programme.desc: Fred Flintstone, the boy from the wrong side of the rocks, courts the beautiful, young heiress Wilma Slaghoople. Along with best friend Barney Rubble, and his future fiancee Betty, Fred and Wilma head off for a romantic weekend in Rock Vegas, the hottest rock resort on the continent.

programme.title: My All American
programme.desc: Awarded a scholarship to the University of Texas at Austin, small but scrappy Freddie Steinmark gets a chance to play football for coach Darrell Royal (Aaron Eckhart) and the Longhorns in the late 1960s. Alongside old teammate Bobby Mitchell and new friend James Street, Steinmark helps the Longhorns find success. When Freddie suffers an injury that leads to a shocking diagnosis, the young man must utilize his indomitable spirit and courage to rise to the challenge like a true champion.

programme.title: Bring It On
programme.desc: The Toro cheerleading squad from Rancho Carne High School in San Diego has got spirit, spunk, sass and a killer routine that's sure to land them the national championship trophy for the sixth year in a row. But for newly-elected team captain Torrance, the Toros' road to total cheer glory takes a shady turn when she discovers that their perfectly-choreographed routines were in fact stolen from the Clovers, a hip-hop squad from East Compton, by the Toro's former captain.

programme.title: Bring It On Again

They resolve to form their own team, pulling together a collection of geeky art students and hippie bleeding hearts whose extracurricular programs were cut for budgetary reasons. Through teamwork, they challenge the official squad's right to represent the school at the upcoming cheerleading championship.

Dave finds a sympathetic ear -- and possibly more -- with the physical therapist (Maeve Quinlan) who comes to treat her.

programme.title: Stomp the Yard

programme.title: Stomp the Yard: Homecoming
programme.desc: A troubled youth (Collins Pennie) must put his problems aside to lead a dance troupe in a national competition.

programme.title: Magic City: An American Fantasy

programme.title: Magic City: An American Fantasy
programme.desc: Magic City became the epicenter of entertainment, drawing legendary celebrities before and during their rise to superstardom; the secret sauce was Mr. Magic's vision; he demanded that his club have the best of everything.

programme.title: Magic City: An American Fantasy
programme.desc: With Mr. Magic in prison, the schemers played, Magic City spiraled into lawlessness as DJs, bartenders, and dancers ran their own side hustles, each believing they were bigger than the club.

programme.title: Magic City: An American Fantasy
programme.desc: The notorious Black Mafia Family drug cartel sets up shop in Magic City; thus begins the "Make It Rain" era of the club, promising more money (and violence) than ever before.

programme.title: It Could Happen to You
programme.desc: Charlie Lang (Nicolas Cage) is a simple, kindhearted New York City cop. When he realizes he has no money to tip waitress Yvonne Biasi (Bridget Fonda), Lang offers her half the winnings of his lottery ticket. Amazingly, the ticket happens to be a winner, in the sum of $4 million. True to his word, Lang proceeds to share the prize money with Biasi, which infuriates his greedy wife, Muriel (Rosie Perez). Not content with the arrangement, Muriel begins scheming to take all the money.

Since Adam is neither human nor demon, gargoyle Queen Leonore (Miranda Otto) and demon Prince Naberius (Bill Nighy) each want him for their own purposes. It is up to Adam to discover his inner humanity and the reason for his continued existence.

Frightening occurrences with unspeakable consequences subsequently unfold, leading the researchers to the realization that they have unleashed a force more terrifying than they could have imagined.

programme.title: The Northman
programme.desc: Prince Amleth is on the verge of becoming a man when his father is brutally murdered by his uncle, who kidnaps the boy's mother. Two decades later, Amleth is now a Viking who raids Slavic villages. He soon meets a seeress who reminds him of his vow -- save his mother, kill his uncle, avenge his father.

programme.title: Pompeii
programme.desc: In 79 A.D., Pompeii, a bustling port city, stands in the shadow of Mount Vesuvius. Milo (Kit Harington), a former slave, is a gladiator who has caught the eye of Cassia (Emily Browning), a wealthy merchant's daughter. However, their difference in social status is not the only obstacle to their love; Cassia has been promised to Corvus (Kiefer Sutherland), a corrupt Roman senator. When the eruption of Mount Vesuvius rains lava and ash down on the city, Milo races to save her before it's too late.

programme.title: The Town
programme.desc: Doug MacRay (Ben Affleck) leads a band of ruthless bank robbers and has no real attachments except for James (Jeremy Renner), who -- despite his dangerous temper -- is like a brother. Everything changes for Doug when James briefly takes a hostage, bank employee Claire Keesey. Learning that she lives in the gang's neighborhood, Doug seeks her out to discover what she knows, and he falls in love. As the romance deepens, he wants out of his criminal life, but that could threaten Claire.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: After a virus turns most people into zombies, the world's surviving humans remain locked in an ongoing battle against the hungry undead. Four survivors -- Tallahassee (Woody Harrelson) and his cohorts Columbus (Jesse Eisenberg), Wichita (Emma Stone) and Little Rock (Abigail Breslin) -- abide by a list of survival rules and zombie-killing strategies as they make their way toward a rumored safe haven in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Halloween Ends
programme.desc: Four years after her last encounter with masked killer Michael Myers, Laurie Strode is living with her granddaughter and trying to finish her memoir. Myers hasn't been seen since, and Laurie finally decides to liberate herself from rage and fear and embrace life. However, when a young man stands accused of murdering a boy that he was babysitting, it ignites a cascade of violence and terror that forces Laurie to confront the evil she can't control.

programme.title: I, Frankenstein
programme.desc: Two centuries after Dr. Frankenstein assembles and reanimates his creature, Adam (Aaron Eckhart) is still living. He becomes embroiled in a war between two immortal races: gargoyles, the traditional protectors of mankind, and evil demons. Since Adam is neither human nor demon, gargoyle Queen Leonore (Miranda Otto) and demon Prince Naberius (Bill Nighy) each want him for their own purposes. It is up to Adam to discover his inner humanity and the reason for his continued existence.

programme.title: Flatliners
programme.desc: Five medical students embark on a daring and dangerous experiment to gain insight into the mystery of what lies beyond the confines of life. The bold adventure begins when they trigger near-death experiences by stopping their hearts for short periods of time. As their trials become more perilous, each must confront the sins from their past while facing the paranormal consequences of journeying to the other side.

Henry, su hijo que dejó una década atrás, de repente se presenta, y cree que ella es la hija de Blanca Nieves y el Príncipe Azul, y la mandaron lejos antes de que la reina malvada practicara su hechizo y congelara el mundo de los cuentos de hadas, es así como ellos terminaron en este mundo. programme.desc: Le papa de Raoul et la maman de Natasha emménagent ensemble. Les deux enfants doivent partager une chambre. Avec des caractères aussi opposés, la cohabitation s'annonce très difficile, surtout lorsqu'il s'agit du rangement.

programme.title: Les minijusticiers
programme.desc: Camille joue les journalistes à l'école. Malgré la réticence de la bande des minijusticiers, Camille les suit jusque dans une mission ultra périlleuse pour prendre des photos volées des cinq copains.

programme.title: Les minijusticiers
programme.desc: Yvon a la pression en ce moment: ses parents lui interdisent les activités extrascolaires tant qu'il ne sera pas le premier de la classe. Finies les virées entre minijusticiers !

programme.title: Les p'tits diables
programme.desc: Toujours en train de se chamailler, Tom et Nina trouvent une idée géniale pour signer la trêve : séparer la maison en deux avec une frontière au scotch. L'indépendance de Microbe Land et Alien Land est déclarée.

programme.title: Les p'tits diables
programme.desc: Nina doit retrouver ses copines pour faire partie des figurantes du clip de Lover Moove qui se tourne en ville. Malheureusement, Papa lui demande de ranger le garage avant d'y aller.

programme.title: Les sisters
programme.desc: Hypnotisée involontairement par une vidéo, Wendy redevient un bébé. Dur, dur pour Marine de se retrouver dans le rôle de la grande sister. Elle va tout faire pour retrouver l'hypnotiseur et réveiller Wendy.

programme.title: Les sisters
programme.desc: Marine fait la boulette de trop en cassant le portable de sa sister. Pour éviter les foudres de Wendy, elle préfère encore jouer les amnésiques ! Wendy tombe dans le panneau et s'efforce de lui faire retrouver la mémoire coûte que coûte.

programme.title: La vie en slip
programme.desc: Carmen et son groupe d'amis sont vraiment sympathiques. Le trio de garçons adorerait être comme eux. Ils vont donc essayer de se glisser dans la peau d'adolescents pour intégrer leur groupe.

programme.title: La vie en slip
programme.desc: Jipé, Pedro et Issa décident de parier qu'ils vont réussir à passer toute une nuit sans dormir. Preuve à l'appui, ils se prennent en photo toutes les heures les yeux grands ouverts. Cependant, la dernière heure Jipé devient somnambule.

programme.title: Angelo la débrouille
programme.desc: De manière inattendue, le prof de sport Zonka démissionne une semaine avant le tournoi de football. Angelo vient à la rescousse !

programme.title: Angelo la débrouille
programme.desc: Victor, Pierre, Alvina, Angelo et son papa vont assister au match de basket des Dragons Rouges. Pour que Victor ne soit pas malade lors du trajet en voiture, Angelo a tout prévu.

programme.title: Kaeloo
programme.desc: Une lettre arrive au Pays Trop Mignon. Cependant, elle n'est adressée à aucun destinataire. Kaeloo, Moignon, Mr Chat et Pretty vont alors mener l'enquête pour découvrir à qui elle est destinée.

programme.title: Kaeloo
programme.desc: Dans un monde d'heroic fantasy, Eugly est enlevée par Olaf. Kaeloo, Moignon, Coin-Coin, Mr Chat et Pretty décident alors de partir à sa rescousse.

programme.title: Kaeloo
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, Kaeloo et ses amis jouent aux cartes. Cependant, Moignon, qui souffre d'indécision chronique, ralentit tout le jeu car il ne sait jamais quelle carte jouer.

programme.title: Kaeloo
programme.desc: Kaeloo et ses amis participent à une émission de télé-réalité nommée "Voice Academy". Les juges sont Pretty, Olaf, Eugly et un mouton et Kaeloo ne va pas leur faciliter la tâche.

programme.title: Défis extrêmes : L'Île de secours
programme.desc: Chris permet à Shawn, Sky et Sugar d'imaginer chacun un défi. Celui de Sky concerne l'athlétisme, celui de Shawn l'évasion et celui de Sugar le talent !

programme.title: Presto ! le Manoir Magique
programme.desc: Pour son anniversaire, Dylan reçoit de Lisa un ticket pour le concert de son groupe préféré. Mais ça tombe à l'eau quand il se retrouve collé et obligé de nettoyer le théâtre. Lisa va tout faire pour être punie afin de passer la soirée avec son ami.

programme.title: Presto ! le Manoir Magique
programme.desc: Alors que les kids jouent à se faire peur, ils entendent des bruits étranges dans le manoir. Le mystère grandit lorsqu'ils découvrent une ombre qui se balade. Ils décident de la prendre en chasse et s'aperçoivent qu'il s'agit de Lorenzo.

programme.title: Presto ! le Manoir Magique
programme.desc: Nica ne sait pas dire non. Aussi, quand Lisa et Violette lui demandent de les assister lors de la journée Portes Ouvertes, Nica accepte. Souci, Lisa et Violette font leur tour sur deux scènes séparées au même moment.

programme.title: Luke, voyageur du temps

programme.title: Luke, voyageur du temps
programme.desc: Luke est en Grèce antique pour chercher la dernière pièce d'astrolabe qui lui manque pour retrouver son grand-père. A Athènes, il croise la route de Théo, un jeune philosophe, qui lui vole son pendule temporel.

programme.title: La vie en slip
programme.desc: Le film Clown Garou 3 vient de sortir au cinéma et c'est un film d'horreur interdit aux moins de 12 ans. Et quand Jipé fait croire à tout le monde qu'il l'a vu pour passer pour un mec courageux, il doit en assumer les conséquences.

programme.title: La vie en slip
programme.desc: Il est fort, musclé et il a plein de tatouages super cool. Voici Jason Tatoo, la star des films d'action adulée par les trois acolytes. Il faut dire qu'il a trop la classe avec ses tatouages : en voilà une bonne idée.

programme.title: Les minijusticiers
programme.desc: Dimitri joue toujours perso lors des activités sportives. Exclu d'un match de foot car il refuse de faire la passe à ses coéquipiers, il devient SuperPerso. Il réalise alors qu'il peut téléporter tous ceux qui refusent de le laisser jouer seul.

programme.title: Les minijusticiers
programme.desc: Dolly a les cheveux bouclés, ce qui lui vaut des moqueries de la part de Carmen, qui tente de la déstabiliser dans la course pour être déléguée de classe. Devenue Superbouclettes, Dolly découvre que ses boucles peuvent s'allonger à volonté.

programme.title: Les minijusticiers
programme.desc: Charlie a les os fragiles. Elle ne peut pas faire une activité sans se casser ou se fouler quelque chose. En devenant Superplâtre, elle se retrouve affublée d'une super armure en plâtre qui lui permet de profiter enfin des activités dont elle rêvait.

programme.title: Défis extrêmes : L'Île de secours

programme.desc: Esteban, un jeune orphelin âgé d'une douzaine d'années, et Zia, une jeune fille Inca, partent vers le Nouveau Monde à la recherche des légendaires Cités d'or.

programme.title: Arthur et les enfants de la table ronde

programme.title: Presto ! le Manoir Magique

programme.title: Luke, voyageur du temps

programme.title: Luke, voyageur du temps
programme.desc: Avec l'aide de Théo, Luke et Jean parviennent à entrer dans l'acropole. Là, ils trouvent Alan qui retient tous leurs amis prisonniers. Mais ils sont loin de se douter du plan maléfique qu'Alan est sur le point d'exécuter.

programme.title: Luke, voyageur du temps

programme.title: Luke, voyageur du temps
programme.desc: Alan est sur le point d'exécuter son plan ultime. Il reste peu de temps à Luke pour libérer Jean et le reste de ses amis qui courent un danger mortel. Heureusement, il peut compter sur le soutien d'Indiana, Jeanne d'Arc et Ling Ling.

programme.title: Kaeloo
programme.desc: Les amis créent leur propre chaîne de télé où plusieurs émissions se succèdent, et elles finissent toutes par être envahies par des extra-terrestres.

programme.title: Angelo la débrouille
programme.desc: Pour impressionner Lilou, Angelo s'introduit dans l'équipe du jeu du Grand Quiz de l'école.

programme.title: Angelo la débrouille
programme.desc: Jordan et sa bande prévoient de détruire l'école d'Angelo grâce au tout puissant "Casque d'Annihilation". C'est une mission pour l'alter-ego super-héros d'Angelo : Dark Angelo.

programme.title: Angelo la débrouille

programme.desc: Pierre a peur de l'eau et ne sait pas nager. C'est la honte vis-à-vis de ses camarades, qui ne se gênent par pour se moquer de lui.

programme.title: Les minijusticiers

programme.title: Les p'tits diables
programme.desc: Tom et Nina découvrent que Cousin Francis passe tout le week-end à la maison. Si au début, Cousin Francis s'amuse bien, il découvre horrifié qu'il a perdu son doudou, Monsieur Serpent.

programme.title: Les p'tits diables
programme.desc: Suite à un mensonge de Nina surpris par Tom, ce dernier arrive à la faire chanter. Sa sœur lui apporte un super cocktail de fruits auquel elle aurait ajouté un prétendu ingrédient alien.

programme.title: Les sisters
programme.desc: Wendy et sa petite soeur, Marine, s'aiment autant qu'elles se détestent. Entre la crise d'adolescence de Wendy et les bêtises innocentes de Marine, c'est le drame perpétuel dans la maison.

programme.title: Les sisters

programme.title: La vie en slip
programme.desc: Après avoir découvert une vieille photo de Ruben avec un gros poisson dans les mains, les garçons découvrent que le père de Pedro a eu un petit succès suite à cette pêche incroyable. Ils veulent donc pêcher un gros poisson pour devenir populaires.

programme.title: La vie en slip
programme.desc: Lorsque le trio découvre qu'une dalle dans la ville vient d'être coulée, ils se précipitent pour y laisser leurs empreintes et accéder à la postérité. Cependant, leur chemin jusqu'à la dalle sera semé d'embûches.

programme.title: Kaeloo
programme.desc: Kaeloo croise Mr Chat chez le Psy et s'empresse de révéler à tout le monde la nouvelle : il est devenu gentil ! Pretty organise une soirée pour aider Mr Chat.

programme.title: Kaeloo
programme.desc: Moignon demande l'aide de Coin-Coin pour aider sa sœur, Lavanade, à contrôler ses pouvoirs. Coin-Coin la prend sous son aile mais Moignon lui reproche, en la faisant développer ses pouvoirs, de la rendre encore plus dangereuse.

programme.title: Kaeloo
programme.desc: Un mouton annonce qu'il va se passer quelque chose mais personne n'a idée de ce dont il s'agit.

programme.title: Kaeloo
programme.desc: Quand Kaeloo propose de changer les règles de Colin-Maillard pour que tout le monde y trouve son compte, la Règle des Jeux intervient.

programme.title: Arthur et les enfants de la table ronde
programme.desc: Arthur accompagne contre son gré Uther en terre d'Avalon pour chasser une licorne, mais le jeune écuyer projette secrètement de faire échouer la chasse.

programme.title: Les mystérieuses cités d'or

programme.title: Luke, voyageur du temps

programme.title: Luke, voyageur du temps
programme.desc: Luke parvient à reconstruire l'astrolabe qui lui indique les coordonnées spacio-temporelles de l'endroit où se trouve son grand-père. Accompagné de Jean, Luke va enfin revoir Paul, mais Alan les attend également.

programme.title: Presto ! le Manoir Magique
programme.desc: Pour Presto, la prochaine compétition est une épreuve collective. Contre toute attente, Lorenzo nomme Nica à la tête de l'équipe. De son côté, Lisa n'en revient pas.

programme.title: Presto ! le Manoir Magique
programme.desc: Daniel trafique le tour de Lorenzo pour faire croire à son oncle qu'il est trop vieux. De leurs côtés, Les jeunes croient pas une seule seconde que leur maître va prendre sa retraite.

programme.desc: Jipé, Issa et Pedro n'en croient pas leurs yeux quand ils constatent que le nouvel accessoire pour être au top de la mode est une dent de croco. Sauf qu'être à la mode ça coûte cher, et les amis n'ont pas les moyens.

programme.title: La vie en slip
programme.desc: Le papy d'Issa lui raconte qu'en 1969, trois types sont devenus instantanément les plus cool du monde juste en allant sur la Lune. Les trois copains adorent l'idée et se mettent en tête de reproduire l'exploit.

programme.title: La vie en slip
programme.desc: Un concours de talents est organisé au quartier et un des membres du jury n'est autre que l'idole de nos trois héros : le rappeur MC Posey. L'occasion en or de faire un selfie avec lui pour se la péter. Ils décident donc de participer à l'évènement.

programme.title: La vie en slip
programme.desc: Pour être cool, il faut regarder la dernière saison de la série à la mode : River Things. Mais pour ça, il faut que la bande trouve quelqu'un qui a un abonnement NET TV. Après quelques déconvenues, ils se retrouvent chez Mme Ronpichon.

programme.title: La vie en slip
programme.desc: Les amis remarquent que tous les mecs cool sont toujours entourés de filles. Ils se mettent en tête de trouver une fille qui voudra bien traîner avec eux. Après avoir essuyé plusieurs refus, Simone accepte.

programme.title: Les mystérieuses cités d'or

programme.title: Angelo la débrouille

programme.title: Les mystérieuses cités d'or

programme.title: Arthur et les enfants de la table ronde

programme.title: Arthur et les enfants de la table ronde

programme.title: Arthur et les enfants de la table ronde

programme.title: Lassie
programme.desc: Zoé souhaite soutenir Mme Lee en remportant la course de caisses à savon car son magasin ne va pas bien ces derniers temps. Cependant, la rivale de Zoé, Samantha, prête à tout pour gagner, recourt à des procédés peu avouables.

programme.title: Lassie
programme.desc: À l'occasion d'une journée d'adoption des chiots du refuge, Zoé se souvient de sa rencontre avec Lassie. À l'époque, Lassie n'était qu'un petit chiot qui avait fui les feux de forêt pour se réfugier dans une grotte où Zoé l'avait découverte.

programme.title: Les minijusticiers
programme.desc: Au moindre brin de pollen, Ronaldo se met à éternuer sans fin ! Ses copains s'apprêtent à lui faire une blague en lui proposant de faire péter un sac en papier rempli d'un mélange de plumes.

programme.title: Les minijusticiers
programme.desc: Nathan se prend sans arrêt des gamelles. Pas besoin de lui faire de croche-patte, il suffit de le regarder et laisser faire. Alors, quand son meilleur pote Paco l'invite à sa course de vélo, on peut craindre le pire.

programme.title: Nos meilleures années
programme.desc: Le quotidien d'une même famille sur trois générations et trois époques clés avec, aux commandes, Françoise, Fanchoune pour les intimes, ado dans les années 60/70, maman dans les années 80/90 et enfin grand-mère aujourd'hui.

programme.title: Médium
programme.desc: Au moment où Allison décide de prendre un peu de distance avec son métier, une enquête criminelle lui est confiée dans l'urgence. Cette affaire est sans indice ni suspect et la vision sollicite la présence du Capitaine Kenneth Push.

programme.title: Médium
programme.desc: Le Capitaine Push se trouve entre la vie et la mort. Allison se bat alors pour déchiffrer des messages confus émanant de l'au-delà, dans l'espoir de stopper le serial killer avant qu'il ne repère sa prochaine victime.

programme.title: Médium
programme.desc: Tous les bruits extérieurs résonnent dans la tête d'Allison au rythme d'une chanson populaire qui se répète inlassablement en boucle. Cette comptine donne des indices à Allison pour localiser une étudiante disparue.

programme.title: Médium
programme.desc: Allison se réveille un matin, elle n'a plus de mari, plus d'enfant, une autre femme vit dans sa maison, elle n'existe plus pour le bureau du procureur et elle s'appelle Beverly. Que s'est-il passé ?

programme.title: Médium
programme.desc: Allison se retrouve en pleine nuit, au milieu de l'autoroute, à essayer d'arrêter les voitures, en hurlant qu'elle a besoin d'argent. Joe la ramène à la maison. Cependant, chaque nuit, elle se relève et fait des choses très étranges.

programme.title: Sydney Fox, l'aventurière
programme.desc: Nigel et Sydney partent en Espagne à la recherche des joyaux de la Couronne. Mais le professeur avec qui ils avaient rendez-vous est mort et l'arme du crime n'est autre que l'arbalète de Sydney...

programme.title: Sydney Fox, l'aventurière
programme.desc: Sydney et Nigel sont poursuivis par des chasseurs de têtes après avoir rerouvé une lancette, avec laquelle Nigel se coupe. Ils doivent affronter un chasseur de relique rival, qui se trouve être le sosie de Nigel.

programme.title: Sydney Fox, l'aventurière
programme.desc: A la recherche d'une relique, Nigel et Sydney se retrouvent impliqués dans l'enquête d'un meurtre. L'arme du crime semble être une relique de l'époque du Roi Arthur...

programme.title: Sydney Fox, l'aventurière
programme.desc: Sydney et Nigel se lancent à la recherche de la boîte de Pandore. Ils s'envolent pour Baraq en Perse et tentent d'entrer dans le palais qui cache la fameuse boîte...

programme.title: Sydney Fox, l'aventurière
programme.desc: Sydney et Nigel font route vers le Moyen-Orient pour trouver une ancienne ceinture de guerrier. Ils font la connaissance d'une charmante fratrie qui recherche cette relique depuis toujours car elle appartenait à leur famille. Mais nos deux héros doivent affronter les guerriers du maître des lieux qui détient la fameuse ceinture.

programme.title: Buffy contre les vampires
programme.desc: Caméra au poing, Andrew tourne un documentaire afin de conserver un témoignage sur la Mission de la Tueuse pour les générations futures. Pendant ce temps, le sceau de Danzalthar est la cause de troubles dans le lycée.

programme.title: Buffy contre les vampires
programme.desc: Craignant que Spike serve encore d'instrument au Premier, Giles propose d'avoir recours à la magie pour révéler le déclencheur et le désactiver. Le vampire voit alors de vieux souvenirs remonter à la surface... Tandis que Giles tente de convaincre Buffy que Spike doit être sacrifié, Robin, avide de vengeance, décide d'en finir avec le vampire...

programme.title: Buffy contre les vampires
programme.desc: Alors qu'elles se dirigent vers Sunnydale, Willow et Faith découvrent une jeune fille poignardée et abandonnée sur la route. Hospitalisée, la Potentielle confie à Buffy qu'elle a été agressée par une sorte de prêcheur nommé Caleb...

programme.title: Buffy contre les vampires
programme.desc: Le Mal ayant pris possession de Sunnydale, les habitants désertent la ville. Buffy culpabilise suite à la défaite qu'elle a essuyé avec Caleb. Des Potentielles sont mortes, d'autres blessées. Alex a perdu un œil... Afin de remonter le moral des troupes, Faith amène les Potentielles au Bronze pour passer du bon temps...

programme.title: Buffy contre les vampires
programme.desc: De retour à Sunnydale, Spike apprend que Buffy a été chassée de sa propre maison en raison de son comportement et de ses décisions qui sont loin de faire l'unanimité... En l'absence de Buffy, Faith est toute désignéepour mener le groupe. Saura-t-elle être à la hauteur ?

programme.title: C'est quoi cette mamie ?!
programme.desc: Une tribu des 7 demi-frères et soeurs doit quitter le grand appart' avant la rentrée. Chacun part en vacances pour l'été avec ses parents respectifs. Gulliver, le petit dernier, est envoyé tout seul chez sa grand-mère. Mais l'excentrique Mamie Aurore n'est pas une baby-sitter comme les autres !

programme.title: C'est quoi cette famille ?!
programme.desc: Bastien, 13 ans, est au centre d'une famille recomposée : 6 demi-frères et soeurs, 8 parents et autant de maisons. Son emploi du temps familial est bien plus complexe que celui du collège.

programme.title: Médium
programme.desc: Dans une vision macabre, Allison assiste au viol et au meurtre d'une jeune fille de 14 ans par son médecin. Seulement, ce médecin schizophrène est enfermé dans un hôpital psychiatrique depuis quinze ans pour nombre d'homicides similaires.

programme.title: Médium
programme.desc: Allison se rend dans une galerie où elle découvre les oeuvres d'un artiste populaire. Alors qu'elle regarde une de ses toiles, des images en trois dimensions sortent de la peinture et l'amènent à penser que le peintre est impliqué dans un crime.

programme.title: Sydney Fox, l'aventurière

programme.title: Inside Pyramids
programme.desc: Mykérinos, le troisième bâtisseur de Gizeh, a choisi de construire une pyramide plus petite que ces deux prédécesseurs. La plus discrète des trois joyaux égyptiens est peut-être celle qui a le plus de choses à révéler.

programme.title: Décolonisations du sang et des larmes
programme.desc: Dès les années 30, les premières revendications d'indépendance se font entendre mais la France reste sourde à ces manifestations. La seconde guerre mondiale va rabattre les cartes et remettre en question le système de domination.

programme.title: Décolonisations du sang et des larmes
programme.desc: Après huit années de conflits meurtriers, l'Empire colonial français craque de toute part. La défaite de Diên Biên Phu oblige la France à abandonner l'Indochine, puis ses comptoirs indiens. Pour tous les peuples colonisés, c'est une étincelle.

programme.title: La seconde guerre mondiale en couleurs
programme.desc: Churchill réalise que le contrôle du canal de Suez en Égypte est essentiel. Renforcés par des troupes venues de tout l'ancien Empire, les Britanniques tiennent bon face aux experts de l'Afrika Corps de Rommel.

programme.title: La seconde guerre mondiale en couleurs
programme.desc: Espérant une victoire rapide, les Alliés envahissent l'Italie en septembre 1943. Cependant, les combats se transforment rapidement en une campagne de plusieurs mois qui fait des milliers de victimes.

programme.title: Espionnes au cœur de la Seconde Guerre mondiale
programme.desc: Vera Atkins est déterminée à mettre en place un réseau d'agentes. Virginia Hall s'évade audacieusement de France. Mathilde Carré est une agente double perfide et Noor Inayat Khan est une princesse musulmane devenue une audacieuse opératrice radio.

programme.title: Espionnes au cœur de la Seconde Guerre mondiale
programme.desc: Noor Inayat Khan, Yolande Beekman et Yvonne Cormeau sont opératrices radio. Ces trois femmes jouent un rôle clé dans l'organisation de la résistance et la communication avec les forces alliées à Londres.

programme.title: Tanks, rois des champs de bataille
programme.desc: Alors même que la guerre cherche son vainqueur, les belligérants jettent dans les batailles des dizaines de blindés en nourrissant le rêve fou que cette débauche d'acier leur permettra de prendre l'avantage et de remporter la victoire décisive.

programme.title: Tanks, rois des champs de bataille
programme.desc: A peine entrés en guerre, à partir de janvier 1942, les Etats-Unis conçoivent des chars légers et moyens à un niveau industriel. Le but est de noyer l'adversaire sous un raz de marée de blindés. Le premier modèle, le char Grant.

programme.title: Une si belle époque ! - La France d'avant 1914
programme.desc: Dans ce court moment qui débute le XXe siècle et qui se termine dans le fracas de la Première Guerre mondiale, les Français ont vécu l'un des plus grands bouleversements culturels et techniques de l'histoire de notre pays. Comme une parenthèse heureuse que, bien des années plus tard, on idéalisera et que l'on appellera, par nostalgie, la Belle Époque.

programme.title: Sur les traces de l'Odyssée
programme.desc: Une plongée sous la surface de l'Odyssée pour comprendre les mystères et les significations de son acte final, lorsque Ulysse retourne dans sa patrie, Ithaque. Nous nous aventurons également au nord du cercle.

programme.title: Les mensonges de l'Histoire
programme.desc: En 1979, Aldo Bonassoli un autodidacte italien, et Alain de Villegas un aristocrate belge, prétendent avoir mis au point une technologie capable de détecter les gisements de pétrole depuis un avion.

programme.title: Les mensonges de l'Histoire
programme.desc: Affaire d'État, manipulation de l'opinion : au coeur de la tragédie du naufrage du paquebot britannique Lusitania se joue l'entrée en guerre des États-Unis.

programme.title: Les citadelles du vertige : trésors du pays Cathare
programme.desc: Longtemps abandonnées, des ruines majestueuses sont perchées au sommet de falaises vertigineuses du Sud de la France. Découvertes par d'intrépides explorateurs au cours des années 1970, ces sentinelles de pierre sont devenues les "châteaux cathares".

programme.title: Les Templiers, de l'histoire à la légende
programme.desc: Il y a 700 ans, le roi de France a mis fin à l'Ordre du Temple en donnant l'ordre d'arrêter tous les Templiers du Royaume. En moins de 200 ans, cet ordre militaire et religieux a fait naître de nombreux mythes qui perdurent encore aujourd'hui.

programme.title: Inside Pyramids
programme.desc: La pyramide de Khéops, construit il y a plus de 4500 ans, renferme encore de nombreux secrets. Pour tenter d'en percer les mystères, une équipe a eu accès aux coulisses de la pyramide.

programme.title: Inside Pyramids
programme.desc: Mykérinos, le troisième bâtisseur de Gizeh, a choisi de construire une pyramide plus petite que ces deux prédécesseurs. La plus discrète des trois joyaux égyptiens est peut-être celle qui a le plus de choses à révéler.

programme.title: Les villes sous l'occupation
programme.desc: Perpignan sous l'occupation, c'est l'histoire d'une ville et de son département, les Pyrénées Orientales, qui vont se retrouver dans la ligne de mire de l'Allemagne nazie du fait de leur frontière avec l'Espagne.

programme.title: Les villes sous l'occupation
programme.desc: Clermont Ferrand est une ville construite en plein coeur du territoire français. Une situation géographique hors norme qui procure à la capitale de l'Auvergne un véritable sentiment de protection.

programme.title: Histoire vivante
programme.desc: Après le 30 janvier 1933, la République de Weimar s'effondre rapidement. Le Reichstag brûle, Dachau ouvre, et le NSDAP devient le seul parti autorisé. La persécution des Juifs s'intensifie.

programme.title: Histoire vivante
programme.desc: Les correspondants de presse français ont été les témoins privilégiés de l'avènement du nazisme en Allemagne au début des années 30. Comment ont-ils perçu la montée du parti national-socialiste dans les urnes ?

programme.title: Hitler, la machine à propagande
programme.desc: La fascination d'Hitler pour la propagande est née dans les tranchées de la Première Guerre mondiale. Là, il l'a vu émerger comme un puissant outil de guerre psychologique. Celui qu'il exploiterait pour construire le mouvement nazi pendant.

programme.title: Hitler, la machine à propagande
programme.desc: Une décennie de propagande, de discours passionnés, d'articles de presse, d'affiches et de campagnes ont conduit à un moment : la nomination d'Hitler au poste de chancelier d'Allemagne en janvier 1933. Une fois en place, le démantèlement.

programme.title: L'enfer de la bataille d'Okinawa
programme.desc: La Bataille d'Okinawa, tout près des côtes japonaises, a pour nom de code : OPERATION ICEBERG. C'est le plus grand assaut de la campagne du Pacifique, et la dernière bataille de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Tanks, rois des champs de bataille
programme.desc: Dès les années 30, les nations européennes ont conçu des projets fous : des croiseurs terrestres et des chars gigantesques. Dans cette course à la folie blindée, ce sont les Allemands qui remportent la palme du gigantisme avec le Maus.

programme.title: Sur les traces de l'Odyssée
programme.desc: Plongée dans les grands mystères de l'Odyssée inspirés par les sentiments de l'âme humaine : la peur, l'amour, la séduction. Grâce à la science, cet épisode invite à aller au-delà du mythe pour y découvrir des réalités cachées sur le monde d'hier.

programme.title: Sur les traces de l'Odyssée
programme.desc: Zoom sur le témoignage inégalé qu'Homère a laissé sur son époque. Une découverte de la science et de la pensée métaphysique d'alors. Les vastes connaissances technologiques et culturelles de l'univers se retrouvent.

programme.title: Inside Pyramids
programme.desc: La pyramide de Khéops, construit il y a plus de 4500 ans, renferme encore de nombreux secrets. Pour tenter d'en percer les mystères, une équipe a eu accès aux coulisses de la pyramide.

programme.title: Les mensonges de l'Histoire
programme.desc: En mars 1985, le Rainbow Warrior, bateau amiral de Greenpeace, est amarré à Auckland en Nouvelle-Zélande. Les activistes préparent une nouvelle action d'envergure pour stopper les essais nucléaires français en Polynésie.

Derrière le sportif, nous rencontrons l'homme qui fait vibrer toute une génération de jeunes surfeurs.

Derrière le sportif, nous rencontrons l'homme qui fait vibrer toute une génération de jeunes surfeurs.

En avril 2015, le coureur de trail Kilian Jornet se prépare pour une expédition à l'Everest, dans le cadre de son projet avec l'alpiniste Jordi Tosas et le cinéaste Sébastien Montaz-Rosset. Deux jours avant leur départ, un séisme secoue le Népal. Les conséquences sont désastreuses et la vallée de Langtang chère à Jordi est anéantie. L'équipe s'envole vers le Népal dans l'espoir d'offrir leur assistance dans cet endroit.

programme.title: Section de recherches
